name: The Demon's Apple
source:
Pomme is the village herbalist and during one of her outings to pick up herbs used to create medicine, she finds a badly wounded man and takes him home to try to save his life. She then discovers he is a demon, a bloodthirsty creature as he bites her to feed himself before escaping. 

But they meet again... And this time they will have to cooperate to survive in a world hostile to both humans and demons.

[From [url=https://kakera-art.itch.io/demons-apple]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
波姆是村里的草药师，在一次外出采摘用于制药的草药时，她发现了一名受重伤的男子，并将他带回家试图挽救他的生命。然后她发现他是一个恶魔，一个嗜血的生物，因为他在逃跑之前咬了她来喂自己。

但他们再次相遇……这一次，他们必须合作才能在人类和恶魔都敌对的世界中生存。

[来自[url=https://kakera-art.itch.io/demons-apple]itch.io[/url]]
